Callout.Name: Indecent Exposure
Callout.Message: Person reported exposing themselves in a park.
Callout.Advisory: Male on foot, no other parties involved.

Script.Line: I was changing. Nobody was supposed to be looking.
I have got a bag right here with my clothes in it.
I am not doing anything. I am sat on a bench.

Lines.Approach: In the park, on his own, and the caller is not making it up. Go and deal with him.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
